name: Armenia
spiritual_teacher: George Gurdjieff (Caucasus roots), ancient Christian monasteries (Geghard, Tatev, Etchmiadzin)
work_strategy: Remote (Sole proprietorship for IT with 5% or 1.5% turnover tax; 180-day visa-free stay)
it_market: Medium (Active expat IT cluster in Yerevan)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0; after 183 days 20% PIT as an individual (UA FOP 5% Single Tax not credited under DTT; without local IE registration).
climate: Temperate (Continental, hot dry summer, snowy winter in Yerevan)
nature: Mountains, Lake Sevan, Canyons (Scenic plateaus and gorges; landlocked)
english_level: Good (Russian widely understood, English in IT and among youth)
citizenship: 3 years (One of the fastest timelines, but requires a language exam)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Visa-free entry with internal or international passport for 180 days.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: No EU-style temporary protection. Refugee status can be obtained on general grounds (2-year Convention travel document).
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **NOT an EU country. EU conscription and protection directives DO NOT APPLY HERE.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: State subsidies only for recognized refugees (family allowance, child benefits).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: The state does not provide housing placement. NGO 'Syunik-Zargatsum' offers help in Yeghegnadzor (guesthouse, office, transfer).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Free primary and emergency care, child care with a social card / refugee card.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: No discounts; Yerevan public transit fare is 100 AMD (~10 UAH).
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Refugees have the right to work without a special permit; a 'Refugee Qualification Passport' can be obtained.
